newsitem.title: CHINA: China's top leaders pay call on Deng Xiaoping.
newsitem.headline: China's top leaders pay call on Deng Xiaoping.

text.p: China's President Jiang Zemin and Premier Li Peng have paid a formal Chinese new year call on paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, state media said on Wednesday.
However, the first official report carried in the Chinese media on Deng since a similar visit by Jiang last year avoided any comment on Deng's health.

"President Jiang Zemin and Premier Li Peng along with other top leaders have paid a visit to Deng Xiaoping, to wish him a happy Spring Festival, good health and long life," the People's Daily said in a front-page report.

Deng, 92, has not been seen in public since the 1994 Chinese lunar new year festival when he visited Shanghai and appeared frail and faltering, and he is now believed to be in fragile health and with fading lucidity.
Jiang and his Politburo colleagues also visited China's other ageing veteran leaders, including Peng Zhen, Yang Shangkun, Wan Li, Song Ping and Bo Yibo, the People's Daily said.

"The veteran leaders asked Jiang and his colleagues to send their seasonal greetings to the Chinese people," the report said, apparently avoiding any direct message from Deng who is sometimes rumoured to be no longer capable of speech.
